construction: Normalize C_s:y^2=f(X),w^2=f(X-s), f=X^3+aX+b. For nonzero Fp s and irreducible f,p>3, C_s has genus4 after separating two infinity branches; H_s:Z^2=f(X)f(X-s) has genus2, map(X,y,w)->(X,yw). Explicit canonical elliptic pullback then H pushforward gives principal conjugate-pair divisor, hence zero. Count fibers independently and test actual point actions.
small_panel: All s=1..p-1 on the retained F11(a2,b7,r7),F17(a2,b2,r19),F211(a0,b7,r199):236 smooth fibers. Count E,C,H over Fp and Fp^2 by square tables and character sums, check all affine C->H maps, record full L_H coefficients,#JacH,r-divisibility and E-polynomial divisibility. special_fibers: For a!=0 use both s=+-delta_f/(3a),delta_f^2=-4a^3-27b^2 (cubic discriminant). t=(s-3b/a)/2,B=a/3-ts gives M(X)=(tX+B)/(X-t), M^2=-s^2 I and F_s(M)(X-t)^6=-s^6 F_s(X). Over Fp^2 choose i^2=-1,l=t+i*s,m=t-i*s,u=(X-l)/(X-m),V=Z(u-1)^3. Verify even sextic, two degree2 elliptic quotients including X=l,m and infinity charts. Retain a0 as formula-not-applicable; do not drop its full fiber panel.

Certify cubic irreducibility by gcd(X^p-X,f)=1 and Frobenius cube, torus character matrix and gcd(r,p^2+p+1); additionally compute gcd for the five supplied P192-run prime orders (not fresh point counts). Build 14-step coupled point streams for G,-G,2G,3G,publicQ,muG,lambdaG; check every (s,X,Z) family image and fixed-fiber closure. Positive G/−G closure and source [r]G=O. A degree6 doubling-polynomial witness excludes constant nonzero fibers for 14-point prefixes at r>28,p>3.
P192_special_action: Construct both special fibers and both elliptic quotients over Fp^2, certify polynomial identities/models and point maps. For each fixed fiber, choose deterministic sqrt branches for P=jG,j1..14; verify quotient points, test F(2G)=[2]F(G), record all scalar-consistency results, and test [r]F(P) for P=G,2G,publicQ on each quotient. boundary: At s0 normalized C has two E components glued at three finite 2-torsion nodes; H has two P1 components glued there. Torus is Res(Fp^3/Fp)Gm/Gm, order p^2+p+1. F11/r7 is positive toric-r control; P192 expected gcd1. Natural correspondence zero and generic fiber non-closure have written proofs; point maps and order tests are separate evidence.
controls: Wrong Z=y+w must fail on some retained points; wrong infinity correction detected; positive elliptic multiplication-by2 and order-r checks; explicit maps/residuals; full fiber enumeration; fresh-copy byte equality; mutated scientific record rejection. Canonical correspondence cancellation is checked via conjugate pairs/principal divisor, not a claimed implementation of full Jacobian arithmetic.
